title: Multi-target benchmark of skill-file-guided agentic virtual screening across eleven drug targets
description: Reproducibility package for the manuscript 'A controlled multi-target benchmark of skill-file-guided agentic virtual screening across eleven drug targets' (single author, submitted to GigaScience as a Technical Note, May 2026). Contents: 202-line virtual-screening skill file (SKILL.md), verbatim agent prompts, 18 agent-emitted parameterised scripts per target, ChEMBL-derived 100-active + property-matched-decoy benchmark library for 11 protein targets across 6 classes (FPR2, EGFR, CDK2, COX-2, ESR1, DPP-4, AChE, BACE-1, HSP90, p38, Thrombin), Uni-Dock GPU docking output, intersection-DeLong analysis, DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis, and true filter ablation. The benchmark suite is intended as a reusable resource for future agentic virtual-screening evaluations.
